chapter.verse: Thuhilhpa za a deih mi in na pha a deih hi, a cihna in thuman thutak ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thuhilhpa in mawhsak nading tawh a kipelh mi, zi khat bek a nei mi, a lungsim kip mi, a khuaval lo mi, a kilawm a kituak-a gamta mi, zindo siam mi, thuhilh siam mi ahi ding hi.
Tua pa in zu ne loin, midang a sat a vua mi hi loin, a lungduai mi, thusia lamah a kiseel hat lo mi, sum a duh lo mi ahi ding hi.
Amah in ama inn pha takpi-in uk zoin a tate, na khempeuhah khuaval loin, a uk thei mi ahi ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, mi khat in a inn a uk zawh kei leh, Pasian’ pawlpi a bangci kep theih ding hiam?
Kisaktheihna tawh hai-in, Dawimangpa’ thuak mawhna thukhenna a thuak ding lauhuai ahih ciangin pawlpi sungah a tum thak mi ahi kei ding hi.
Tua tham loin, amah in kosiatna leh mawhsakna leh Dawimangpa’ thangsiahna tawh a kipelh nadingin a pualam mi lakah zahtakna a ngah mi ahi ding hi.
Tua mah bangin pawlpi upate in zong khuaval lo mi, thu lang gen lo mi, zu dawnin a noptat lo mi, sum siangtho lo deih lo mi ahi ding uh a,
theihna lungsim siangtho tawh upna thu thukpi a zang ding uh hi.
Tua mite in a masa-in ze-etna thuak ta uh hen. Tua nung ciangin mawhsak nading a om kei leh, pawlpi upa na sem ta uh hen.
Tua mah bangin amau’ zite in zong khuaval lo ding uh a, mite’ dai nading thu gensiam mi hi loin thuman thutak a nei mi, na khempeuhah a diktat mi ahi ding uh hi.
Upate in zi khat bek nei-in, amau’ tate leh a inn uh a pha takpi-in uk ta uh hen.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, upa na pha takpi-a a semte in amau adingin a hoih a phatna ahi zongin, Khazih Zeisu sungah a om upna hangah launa om lohna a ngah uh hi.

Nangma kiangah a sawt loin ka hong pai ding hi ci-in ka lamet hangin, a sawt veipi ka khawl leh, nangmah in Pasian’ innpi sungah mite in bang ci gamtat ding uh hiam cih na theih nadingin, hih bang lai gelhin ka hong pia hi. Tua innpi in a nungta Pasian’ pawlpi, thuman thutak khuam leh bulpi ahi hi.

Pasian biakna thu thukpi in bang zah lian hiam cih nial nading a om kei hi: ‘Amah in pumpi-ah a kilang hi, a thumanna Kha Siangtho tawh a kilang hi, vantungmite in a mu uh hi, minam khempeuh lakah a thu kihilh hi, Leitung khempeuh ah a thu ki-um hi, minthan’na tawh vantungah kilak tohna a ngah hi.’
